caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape and a reddish-brown color. The chest features dovetail joinery on the corners and stands on four short bracket feet. It has a single large drawer at the bottom, with two round, dark-colored knobs and a circular keyhole in the center of the drawer. Above the drawer, there is a large compartment with a keyhole in the center of the front panel, and the edges of the lid slightly overhang the sides and front. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorations, and there is a faint handwritten inscription near the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Blanket Box
